## XcodeClient class

Xcode client for HTTP-based macOS automation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class XcodeClient
```

## Example

```typescript
const client = new XcodeClient({
  apiKey: process.env.MACTS_API_KEY!,
})

// List calendars
const calendars = await client.calendars.list()
```
